title: Receipt line, decomposed
prompt:
Implement two cooperating methods:

- `static String formatMoney(double amount)` — formats as `$NN.NN` with exactly two decimals (`formatMoney(5)` is `$5.00`).
- `static String line(String item, int qty, double price)` — returns `"item xN = $NN.NN"` where the money part comes from `formatMoney` of `qty * price`. Example: `line("pen", 3, 1.5)` is `"pen x3 = $4.50"`.

tests.name: receipt line
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.line("pen", 3, 1.5), "pen x3 = $4.50", "3 pens");
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.line("book", 1, 9.99), "book x1 = $9.99", "single book");
tests.hint: line() must call formatMoney — compose, don't duplicate.
